results.rationale: Consistency: the pizza's round crust and pepperoni arrangement are retained, with minor topping-texture changes. Instruction: the centered pizza, orange-yellow radiant background, floating herbs/chilies and exact bold top title are present; cheese appears as blocks rather than strings and steam/heat distortion is weak. Quality: the poster is coherent, its title is legible and the food/graphic elements have clean recognizable forms.

Consistency: the map outline and region divisions persist, but the black borders become white throughout. Instruction: all regions receive the four requested colors, but the four-color game is only partially fulfilled because several adjoining regions share a color. Knowledge: no explanation is supplied; visible violations include the adjacent red regions at left, adjacent yellow central regions, and the two blue bottom regions. Quality: the map has clean boundaries, even fills and no distracting artifacts.
